subtitle: Lesson 9 · Before any LLM touches a query

eyebrow: The one rule: never string-concatenate SQL
code:
# VULNERABLE
query = f"SELECT * FROM customers WHERE name='{name}'"
cursor.execute(query)

# SAFE -- value passed as data, never as syntax
query = "SELECT * FROM customers WHERE name = %s"
cursor.execute(query, (name,))
caption: Same for sqlite3 (?), psycopg2 (%s) -- every major driver.
If the role can't write, a bad query can't destroy anything.

subtitle: Now that the connection is safe, bring in the model.
